title: Account for reacquisition of common stock

items.concept: Treasury stock cost method — purchase, reissue above/below cost, period-end equity, subsequent retirement, direct-retirement alternative
Number-variant twin — treasury purchase, reissue above/below cost, period-end equity, retirement; direct retirement when cash < original issue
Period-end equity emphasis — multi-lot FIFO treasury cost schedule and year-end reissuance below cost with equity presentation
Cost-method reissuance below cost — debit PIC—Treasury Stock first, then Retained Earnings; no income-statement loss
Treasury holding vs direct retirement — issued vs outstanding shares; treasury is contra equity not an asset
